title: Canonical Factual Projection shared read-contract consolidation
objective: Make executive pages, diagnostics, Research Gaps and owner-assessment inputs consume one governed Canonical Factual Projection or explicitly governed derivative.
accepted_audit_option: Option A — Canonical Factual Projection first
implementation_summary: Canonical Factual Projection is the shared factual read contract for executive presentation, diagnostics, Research Gaps, owner-assessment input state and Observation input where applicable.

Executive pages render canonical factual sections as labelled executive facts with Evidence, Unknown, Contradiction, relationship, membership, lineage, candidate state, projection version and runtime fingerprint context.
Advanced Diagnostics reports the same Canonical Factual Projection inventory, rendered fields, omitted fields, omission reason, consumer version and runtime fingerprint used by visible pages.
Research Gaps and owner-assessment wording distinguish supplied candidate facts from pending governance and genuine deficiencies without changing promotion authority.
expected_visible_outcomes: Industry Overview rendered as executive-friendly factual sections;
BT Group and other Enterprise Dossiers showing supplied facts;
Advanced Diagnostics agreeing with page content;
Research Gaps distinguishing supplied facts from genuine deficiencies;
existing Participant and Programme behaviour preserved;
unchanged_behaviour: TEL-001 package contents and checksum remain unchanged.
Blueprint validation, staging, review, governance, promotion and owner authority remain unchanged.
Observation generation remains additive and is not required for factual display.
No automatic acceptance, promotion, recommendations or TEL-001-specific production logic are introduced.
required_test_steps: Open /blueprint-import and confirm the CURRENT PILOT CHANGE panel is visible before upload.
Import or restage the unchanged TEL-001 ZIP and confirm checksum bd3924d85125e308e36cc3f0b02af38e3eca7d163640d0d2c95aa7a861441d07.

Open Industry Overview, BT Group Enterprise Dossier, Market Participants, Major Programmes, Opportunities and Reinvention Timing and confirm supplied TEL-001 facts render without raw dictionary/list syntax.
Open Advanced Diagnostics and confirm factual counts, rendered fields, omitted fields and runtime fingerprint match the visible pages.
Open Research Gaps and confirm supplied facts are not classified as wholly absent and owner-assessment pending is not presented as source absence.
known_limitations: Operator validation cannot be inferred from repository tests and defaults to Not yet tested until a human records deployed validation.
Fresh-import guidance depends on deployment timestamp and import timestamps being available in runtime metadata.
Owner assessment and promotion remain governed external authorities; this sprint preserves candidate factual display but does not auto-authorise recommendations.
validation_status: Automated TEL-001 regression pending in deployed runtime; repository regression suite is the Codex merge gate.
automated_validation_result: Run tests/test_tel001_blueprint_import_regression.py against the unchanged TEL-001 package after this deployment.
